map.气体反应平衡常数换算 使用指南: Gas Reaction Equilibrium Constant Converter User Guide
map.输入 Kc、温度与气体摩尔数变化 Δn，求 Kp（R=8.314，T 为开尔文）: Enter Kc, temperature and the gas mole change Δn to get Kp (R = 8.314, T in kelvin).
map.Kp↔Kc 互算：给定 Kc、T 与 Δn（气体计量差）求 Kp。: Convert between Kp and Kc: given Kc, T and Δn (gas stoichiometric difference) find Kp.
map.Δn 判定：由反应式气体计量系数差定 Δn 符号，影响换算方向。: Δn determination: the sign of Δn is set by the difference in gas stoichiometric coefficients, which sets the direction of conversion.
map.温度影响：RT 项随 T 变化，提示 Kp 与 Kc 一般不等。: Temperature effect: the RT term varies with T, indicating that Kp and Kc are generally unequal.
map.：输入 Kc=0.5、T=298K、Δn=1，工具输出 Kp≈12.3（RT≈2: : entering Kc = 0.5, T = 298 K, Δn = 1, the tool outputs Kp ≈ 12.3 (RT ≈ 24.6 L·atm/mol) and notes that Kp = Kc when Δn = 0.
map.根据投料量与化学计量比确定限量反应物与理论产量: Limiting Reactant and Theoretical Yield from Feed Amounts and Stoichiometric Ratio
map.由溶质与溶液质量求质量分数（浓度）: Mass Fraction (concentration) from Solute and Solution Mass
map.质量转物质的量（n = m / M）: Mass to amount of substance (n = m / M)
map.生成气体计量和减反应气体计量和；无气体或相等则 Δn=0，Kp=Kc。: Sum the gas stoichiometric coefficients of products and subtract those of reactants; with no gas or equal amounts Δn = 0 and Kp = Kc.
map.R 用哪个值？: Which value of R is used?
map.与 P 单位匹配：P 用 atm 取 0.0821 L·atm/(mol·K)；: Match the units of P: with P in atm take 0.0821 L·atm/(mol·K); with Pa take 8.314.
map.Kp 和 Kc 量纲一样吗？: Do Kp and Kc have the same dimensions?
map.数值与量纲不同（因 (RT)^Δn 带单位），不可直接比大小。: The values and dimensions differ (because (RT)^Δn carries units), so they cannot be compared in magnitude directly.
